name: Deep Agents Long-Horizon Harness
mechanism: Adds planning, subagents, filesystem workspaces, context offloading, skills, memory, shell tools and human approval over a LangGraph runtime.
use_when: A long-horizon research or coding worker needs most harness capabilities together
Workspace isolation and delegated subagent contexts are explicit requirements
avoid_when: Only a small embedded tool loop is required
No real sandbox can constrain filesystem, shell and network authority
expected_effects: Faster assembly of long-horizon workspace agents
Built-in context offloading and delegated work surfaces
failure_modes: Broad default capabilities exceed workload authority
Tool or sandbox configuration exposes host data and commands
Harness and LangGraph upgrade behavior leaks through the abstraction
required_evals: sandbox escape and filesystem boundary tests
subagent fan-out cost and completion rate
